themes.title: Far-right push for 'national priority' policies
themes.blurb: Right-wing parties across Europe continue to advocate for policies that prioritize citizens over immigrants in housing, social aid, and employment. This theme has intensified with recent legislative proposals and public statements in Spain, Italy, and Sweden, reflecting a broader transnational trend.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Demands national priority in housing and social aid in Valencia and Castilla-La Mancha.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Supports policies favoring Italian citizens in social welfare and housing access.

countries.name: 🇸🇪 Sverigedemokraterna
countries.note: Proposes shrinking administrative models and prioritizing Swedish citizens in social policies.

countries.name: 🇳🇴 Fremskrittspartiet
countries.note: Advocates for stricter immigration controls and national priority in public services.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Pushes for policies favoring French citizens in housing and employment.

themes.title: U.S.-Iran peace deal dominates global discourse
themes.blurb: The recent U.S.-Iran peace deal signed by President Trump has sparked intense reactions across multiple countries. Right-wing and far-right parties are either praising the deal as a diplomatic victory or criticizing it as insufficient, reflecting a shared global focus on Middle Eastern geopolitics.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: Trump administration signs deal, touts it as a major diplomatic achievement.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Meloni cautiously welcomes the deal but emphasizes Western unity.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Praises the deal as a step toward stability but remains skeptical of Iran's compliance.

countries.name: 🇵🇱 Prawo i Sprawiedliwość
countries.note: Criticizes the deal for not addressing Poland's security concerns.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Calls the deal a surrender, demands stronger stance against Iran.

themes.title: Internal divisions within far-right parties
themes.blurb: Far-right parties in Europe and the Americas are experiencing internal fractures, with leadership struggles and ideological disputes threatening their cohesion. These divisions are evident in Italy, Argentina, and the UK, where party infighting has dominated recent news cycles.

themes.title: Javier Milei’s declining approval amid internal strife
themes.blurb: Argentinian President Javier Milei's approval ratings are declining as his government faces internal strife, particularly over the scandal involving his Chief of Staff, Manuel Adorni. This theme has resonated in Argentina and among right-wing observers in the U.S. and Europe.

countries.note: Italian right-wing media analyzes Milei's challenges as part of broader populist trends.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox

themes.title: Far-right reactions to Middle East conflicts
themes.blurb: Right-wing and far-right parties across the globe are reacting to the ongoing Middle East conflicts, particularly the U.S.-Iran deal and Israel's stance. These reactions range from support for diplomatic solutions to calls for stronger military actions, reflecting a shared concern over regional stability.

countries.note: Criticizes Iran deal for undermining Poland's security interests.
